Most shops run their pipeline from memory, a text thread, and a notebook by the register.

Black Arrow OS is a free pocket CRM that runs in your browser: drag-and-drop pipeline stages, follow-up scheduling, and a weekly KPI dashboard with CPL and ROAS.

No signup. No card. The free edition holds 25 contacts, enough to run every open lead you've got right now.

Open it this morning. Load in every lead sitting in your head or your texts. Set a follow-up date on each one before you close the tab.
